scope: Every US city or county with its own general minimum wage in force on 2026-01-05, plus phases taking effect later in 2026. Rates in USD per hour (general rate; size tiers as separate fields).

conventions.rate: General adult rate in USD/hour. Where an ordinance has size tiers, rate is the largest-employer tier and the other tiers are separate fields.
conventions.endDateExclusive: Date the next phase replaces this row. For indexed ordinances it is the next annual adjustment date even when that amount is not recorded here.
conventions.censusGeoid: 7-digit Census place GEOID for cities; 5-digit county FIPS for counties (2024 Census Gazetteer).
conventions.surpassedByState: Ordinance on the books but below the state minimum; the state rate is shown because it governs.

excluded: Industry-only or contractor-only wages (Long Beach/LA/West Hollywood hotel workers, health care, fast food statewide in CA, airport-only wages) except SeaTac, whose initiative covers its hospitality and transportation sectors.
